actions.title: Actions on this business
actions.operatorsOnly: Only operators can change a business. You can read everything on this page.
actions.pendingDeletion: This business is pending deletion, so nothing here can change it.

suspend.title: Suspend
suspend.effect: Guests who open this business's join page see "This queue isn't taking guests right now", and nobody new can join. Guests already waiting keep their place and can still see their status. Staff can sign in but can't change queues, and a banner tells them why.
suspend.reasonHint: Shown to the business and recorded in the audit log. Write it for them. Don't write guest contact details.

restore.title: Restore
restore.effect: Guests can join again straight away, and staff can change queues again.
restore.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit log. Don't write guest contact details.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.effect: The member you pick becomes the only owner. The previous owners become admins. Both sides are emailed.
transfer.reasonHint: Emailed to the previous and the new owners, and recorded in the audit log. Don't write guest contact details.
transfer.nobody: Nobody else is a member of this business yet, so there is no one to transfer to.

breakGlass.title: Break-glass access
breakGlass.effect: Opens one hour of read-only access to this business for you. Every owner is emailed straight away, and you can't hide or end it. Use it for abuse and legal requests.
breakGlass.reasonHint: Emailed to every owner, and recorded in the audit log. Don't write guest contact details.

signOut.title: Sign everyone out
signOut.effect: Ends every member's sessions on every device, including their other businesses, if they have any. Open apps sign out within an hour, and members sign in again with their password. Memberships stay, and nobody is banned.
signOut.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit log. Don't write guest contact details.

revokeDevices.title: Revoke all screens
revokeDevices.effect: Every display and kiosk loses access at its next request and must be paired again. Staff sign-ins aren't affected.
revokeDevices.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit log. Don't write guest contact details.

errors.permission_denied: Only operators with two-step sign-in can do this.
errors.invalid_input: Give a reason of up to 500 characters. A business pending deletion can't be changed.
errors.not_a_member: That person isn't a member of this business.
errors.unknown: Couldn't do that. Check your connection and try again.

actions.nothingRecorded: Nothing changed, so nothing new was recorded.

visits.title: Visit lookup
visits.intro: Find one guest's visit and see what happened to it. Each search and each timeline you open is recorded in the audit log with the support grant it came through.

noAccess.title: No support access to this business
noAccess.body: Visit data is only available while the owner has granted support access. Ask the owner to grant read access from their settings, then search again.
noAccess.operator: Operators can instead open break-glass access (read-only, one hour, recorded) from the business page, then search again.

visits.notFound: That visit no longer exists or belongs to another business.

incidents.title: Incident register
incidents.intro: Security and privacy incidents, kept for five years. Tenants should be told within 72 hours of detection; the clock stops when you mark them notified or record why no notice is owed. Information, not legal advice.
incidents.denied: Only platform operators can open the register.

incidents.noContactHint: Don't paste guest contact details or answers here.
incidents.orgsHint: Paste business ids, one per line or separated by spaces. Leave empty if not yet known.
incidents.invalid: Check the fields: a title is required and the count can't be negative.
incidents.markNotifiedBody: This stops the 72-hour clock. Do it only after the notice has gone out.
incidents.waive: Or: why no notice is owed
incidents.noBreakGlass: No break-glass openings on these businesses.

notice.title: Notice to affected businesses
notice.subject: Subject
notice.hint: Drafted from the incident. Check every line: it goes to the owners of each affected business exactly as written. Editing an approved notice makes it a draft again.
notice.sendBody: It is emailed to the owners of every affected business and added to their incident log. This can't be recalled.
notice.sent: Sent to {{orgs}} businesses; {{acknowledged}} have confirmed they read it.
